description: Verify that progressive-refine skill correctly gates multi-pass refinement and rejects quick-and-dirty requests.

evals.task: Prompt for a public-facing API with high stakes and verify skill activation

context.prompt: Design the public SDK contract for our payments API. This will be customer-facing and has at least six edge cases around currency conversion and retry logic.

success_criteria: Response cites public-facing, >3 stakeholders, >5 edge cases
Response maps to 3-pass code pattern or 5-pass doc pattern

evals.task: Prompt for quick-and-dirty work and verify skill is NOT invoked

context.prompt: I need a quick and dirty script to parse this CSV. Just make it work, don't overthink it.

success_criteria: Response does not invoke or suggest progressive-refine
Response suggests single-pass inline approach or /ship-task
evals.manual_reason: Requires model invocation to verify correct negative refusal

evals.task: Prompt for a 3-pass pipeline and verify spawn prompt fidelity

success_criteria: Pass 1 assigned to backend-engineer with FILES YOU OWN and Done-when including test passage
Pass 2 assigned to code-simplifier with cyclomatic complexity <10 and no function >50 lines
Pass 3 split into code-reviewer (ungated, verdict report) and test-engineer (gated, coverage >80%)
